verdict.reasons: The candidate image successfully features the required white-and-blue AFP drip-tape carton with authentic, highly readable branding and the approved sleeve captions. The installed agricultural scene accurately depicts neutral seedlings and continuous flat drip-tape laterals with realistic localized root-zone wetting, matching the article's agromonomics intent. The expected legitimate watermark is clearly visible. The composition is a unified, non-collaged scene with plausible geometric integration and an appropriate clearance gap around the packaging. No core defects or minor warnings requiring score reduction were found.
